theory.target: Audit the hypothesis and dependency boundary of the exact triangle-free even-hole-free list-coloring corollary; preserve the canonical fragment unchanged.
definitions: Finite simple undirected graphs; holes are induced cycles of length at least four.
d-degeneracy quantifies over every nonempty induced subgraph.
k-choosability quantifies over every list assignment of size at least k over arbitrary finite palettes.
Both chromatic invariants equal zero on the null graph by convention.
assumptions: Both triangle-freeness and even-hole-freeness are required.
The unbounded deduction assumes the external structural theorem; finite enumeration is limited to n<=6.
The imported fragment and open/exact metadata remain unverified and unchanged.
approaches_considered: Use hereditary bisimplicial structure, low-degree removal, and reverse-greedy list coloring.
Enumerate finite graphs and independently check cycles, all induced degrees, and exact colorings.
falsification_targets: Find a class member of degeneracy above two or a coloring mismatch.
Falsify the bipartite/2-degenerate shortcut with an exact bad list assignment.
Check primary statement placement and corrected theorem dependency.

claims.statement: Among all 33,868 labelled simple graphs on 0..6 vertices, 3,716 are triangle-free and even-hole-free; each has degeneracy at most two, and ordinary chromatic numbers follow the null/edgeless/forest/cyclic classification.
claims.falsification_condition: Any omitted or misclassified graph, invalid order, degree-bound violation, or exhaustive-coloring mismatch.

claims.statement: Every bipartite 2-degenerate graph is 2-choosable. The specified K2,4 two-list assignment falsifies this stronger implication.
claims.falsification_condition: A proper coloring of the six specified lists would refute the obstruction certificate.

claims.statement: The frozen imported text is a splice in the explanation after Conjectures 2, 3 and 4 in AIM section G.4, not a complete standalone conjecture.
claims.falsification_condition: Primary PDF placement contradicts the splice mapping or supplies a conclusion within the frozen text.

claims.statement: Chudnovsky and Seymour state the bisimplicial-vertex theorem and document a clique-transfer error in the older proof, supplying a replacement argument.
claims.falsification_condition: The cited author-hosted paper lacks the stated theorem or correction; this is not independent verification of its full proof.

claims.statement: Conditional on the cited structural theorem, finite triangle-free even-hole-free graphs have equal ordinary and list chromatic numbers, with values 0,1,2,3 for null, non-null edgeless, forest-with-edge, and cyclic graphs respectively.
claims.falsification_condition: A counterexample within the stated class, a failure of the external theorem, or a gap in the hereditary-degree/reverse-greedy/odd-cycle argument.

progress.summary: Store 3,716 low-degree removal certificates and a complete n<=6 classification; map the arbitrary-list upper bound to reverse-greedy coloring. No universal proof from finite testing.
Exact K2,4 bad two-list certificate retires the bipartite/2-degenerate shortcut; no novelty claim.
Identify the incomplete source fragment and the replacement dependency after a documented earlier proof error.

checks.method: Counterexample and boundary probes first; cycle edge/chord masks, every induced-subgraph minimum degree, and exhaustive ordinary coloring. Then independently validate stored removal orders.
checks.independence_basis: Fresh python -I process reads only input.json; no theory output/code. Distinct recognition and degree algorithms. Certificate audit runs afterward and explicitly reads certificates. Same assistant authored both; not independent model/human review.
checks.result: Both algorithms agree on all 33,868 graphs, 3,716 eligible, zero classification discrepancies; 64 bad-list assignments rejected, eight edge deletions repaired, all stored orders validated.
blocking_objections: No exhaustive arbitrary-palette list enumeration; upper bounds use the explicit greedy argument.
No kernel acceptance or independent human/model proof review.

checks.method: Inspect AIM section G.4 and theorem 1.1 plus the correction paragraph in the author-hosted replacement paper; compare arXiv version metadata.

Do not use the older clique-transfer step as a verified premise; retain the replacement theorem as an explicit external dependency and the fragment as a scope objection.
